content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. The investigator did not question Complainant on claims 1-3 and 5-9 and only asked her to verify them. No affidavits were taken from the six coworkers she named as witnesses (Coworkers 2-7), and no reason is given for omitting them. Coworker 1, the central comparator and subject of the alleged retaliation, is not addressed either. The only other statements come from higher-level officials and an HR specialist who lacked knowledge of the claims. The hostile work environment, retaliation and constructive discharge allegations therefore rest largely on the Supervisor's account, so the FAD's finding of no discrimination cannot be reliably evaluated until these gaps are filled."}
